name: invocation
help:
usage: work invocation {parse,confirm} ...

Retired: invocation parse/confirm return invocation_command_retired. The Host selects the Work mode.

children.name: parse
children.help:
usage: work invocation parse --input-file INPUT_FILE

Retired: invocation parse returns invocation_command_retired.

children.name: confirm
children.help:
usage: work invocation confirm --input-file INPUT_FILE

Retired: invocation confirm returns invocation_command_retired.
